value.rationale: The natural full additive-convolution recovery problem for cyclic proper ternary colourings differs sharply from the ordinary chromatic count and lower-band sampling. It has an exact infinite period-three loss-of-information transition, precise multinomial zero multiplicity and a quantified 1/k disappearing fractional loss. These are structural all-length invariants useful for distinguishing recoverable Fourier modes, not arbitrary sample-size statistics.
